text: I'm sorry to bother anyone so late. I am grandad to Ellie who is 6, she's sleeping over with us. She has a temperature of 38.4 and I think she looks wrong, her skin is gone very pale and sort of mottled, patchy on her legs and arms, and her lips look a bit bluish to me, though it might be the lamp light, I'm not sure. She didn't look like that earlier. I don't want to make a fuss over nothing but my wife said to message. What should we do?
